channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Doug McDermott | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Doug McDermott from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Doug McDermott, Jalen Smith, Isaiah Jackson
item.description:
“McDermott went in there and played well. Isaiah Jackson brought a lot of fight to the game. Jalen Smith hasn't had much of an opportunity to play in the playoffs, so I wanted to see where he was at. We weren't giving up, but it was an opportunity to get some energetic fresh guys in there to fight. They did some good things.”

Rick Carlisle on Doug McDermott, Jalen Smith, Isaiah Jackson, May 24, 2024. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell
item.description:
Scott Agness:Carlisle:

“The priority is to get the new staff in here, work towards good health as much as we can, try to get McConnell and McDermott re-signed if we can do that.”

Rick Carlisle on Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Jun 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell
item.description:
#Pacers president Kevin Pritchard on soon-to-be FAs McConnell and McDermott:

“They're core to what we've done. They're two feet in on the Pacers. They were super thankful for Nate. ... There's certain roles they're good at. At times we probably played them too much.”

Kevin Pritchard on Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart
item.description:
Redick:

“In my little circle of T.J. McConnell, Doug McDermott, Tobias Harris and Josh Hart, it was usually me. But Josh has got some great Bordeaux in his collection. But he also had some shipped in. The last night I was there, I didn’t have enough room in my luggage to transport all of the wine back home to New York. So I brought six or seven bottles to the Grand Floridian hotel. I had a little wine meal with Timothé Luwawu-Cabarrot, Russell Westbrook, Doug, TJ and myself. Then (former Pelicans coach) Alvin Gentry and (Orlando Magic general manager) John Hammond happened to be sitting at the table next to us. So I shared a couple of sips with them.”

JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart, Sep 21, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Doug McDermott
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle:

“We like McDermott very much. Terrific shooter, great player without the ball & we definitely view him as a winning player & our kind of guy. We got a second-round pick in the deal somewhere in the middle of the second. Most people forecast it to be a deep draft.”

Rick Carlisle on Doug McDermott, Feb 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Scott Perry on Doug McDermott
item.description:
In retrospect, it’s hard to imagine them coming up with a more successful return than they got from Oklahoma City, landing Enes Kanter, Doug McDermott as well as the second-round pick of the Bulls, which right now sits at No. 31, just outside of the first round.

“I've been very pleased with the additions of both Enes and McDermott,”

Scott Perry on Doug McDermott, Dec 9, 2017. Source: Bergen Record.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Pau Gasol, Doug McDermott, Bobby Portis
item.description:
“I sit there and listen to (Gasol) talk. He talks to Doug (McDermott), he talks to Bobby (Portis),”

Taj Gibson on Pau Gasol, Doug McDermott, Bobby Portis, Feb 20, 2016. Source: CSN Chicago.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Doug McDermott
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on McDermott:

“I like Doug a lot. He's going to be a good pro. This will be a good opportunity for him.”

Tom Thibodeau on Doug McDermott, Mar 3, 2015. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Doug McDermott
item.description:
Sam Smith:Rose on McDermott flaw:

“He forgot to bring (rookie job) donuts. He set 3 alarms and forgot that; I’m going to have to ask him aboutthat.”

Derrick Rose on Doug McDermott, Sep 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @SamSmithHoops.
